dessin: A map legend cartouche, empty, seen flat from the front: one landscape flat pale rectangle #FBFCF8 with a 2 px ink outline and a second thin ink outline offset just outside it (a double frame), sharp square corners. Across the top, a header band about one ninth of the cartouche height, closed below by a thin double horizontal ink rule (two thin parallel lines close together) running across the full inner width; the header band is completely empty, plain pale color. Below the double rule, the whole body of the cartouche is completely empty plain pale paper: no symbols, no boxes, no lines, no bars, no text. Nothing else.
